title: Skeleton2D with default Bone2D nodes causes affine_invert: Condition "det == 0" is true error on run
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot v4.6.1.stable.official.14d19694e
*(Tested on Windows 11, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti, Vulkan Forward+)*

Not tested in: other versions yet. (If you have time, please check 4.5.stable, [4.7.dev](https://4.7.dev/) to see if it’s a regression.)

### System information

Windows10 - Godot v4.6.1.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (Driver 572.83)

### Issue description

When creating a new scene with a Skeleton2D node containing two default Bone2D children (no scripts, no animations, no custom transforms), running the scene triggers the following error in the output console:

text
E 0:00:01:999   affine_invert: Condition "det == 0" is true.
  <C++ 源文件>     core/math/transform_2d.cpp:51 @ affine_invert()
The error occurs even though all transforms are identity matrices. It suggests that somewhere in the Skeleton2D/Bone2D internal code, an affine inversion is attempted on a singular transform (determinant == 0). This should not happen for a freshly created, unmodified skeleton.

Expected behavior:
A default Skeleton2D with default Bone2D nodes should run without any errors, as there is no degenerate transform present.

Actual behavior:
The error is emitted immediately when the scene is run, even without any user code.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new empty project.

Create a new scene (e.g., Main.tscn).

Add a Skeleton2D node.

Add two Bone2D nodes as children of Skeleton2D (the exact hierarchy: Skeleton2D → Bone2D → Bone2D).
*Do not change any properties – keep all transforms at default values (scale = 1, rotation = 0, position = 0).*

Run the scene (F5).

Observe the error in the output console.

No scripts, animations, or any additional nodes are needed to reproduce.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Attached is a zip archive containing a minimal project that reproduces the issue. It includes only:

project.godot

Main.tscn (with the Skeleton2D + two Bone2D as described)

No .godot folder is included.

(Upload your MRP zip here; make sure it is under 10 MB.)
If you prefer, you can describe that the MRP is a fresh project with only the scene described above.
